WETH address 0xC02a...6Cc2 used with the current contract address to derive the Uniswap pair.

Payable transfer that delegates entirely to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Guarded by checkBots; performs allowance accounting and balance updates with unchecked arithmetic.

Owner-only function that delegatecalls an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Pure CREATE2-style pair address derivation using keccak256 over token addresses and the Uniswap factory init code hash.
Owner-only listing routine that rewrites total supply allocations, calls addLiquidityETH, calls stopTheBots, and loops over arbitrary recipient arrays minting balances.
Caller-controlled address used for authentication, allowance accounting and token movement.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as the Uniswap deadline (block.timestamp + 600) in list().
Transaction origin used as the owner identity and as an infinite-allowance holder in the constructor.
Arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and calldata inside delegate().
Raw .call to stopTheBots with selector 0x15274141; gas is forwarded and no return data validation exists besides the boolean require.

External payable call to the Uniswap router forwarding msg.value and a deadline derived from block.timestamp.

edges.reason: PimpMyInu constructor reads tx.origin to establish ownership and privileged allowances.
owner is assigned from tx.origin, making ownership phishing/relayable via an intermediary contract.
allowance[tx.origin][uniPair] is set to uint(-1), granting an unlimited allowance tied to the transaction origin.
Constructor writes the owner state variable used for all owner-only checks.
Constructor stores the pair returned by pairFor into uniPair.
Constructor invokes pairFor(wrappedBinance, address(this)).
Constructor writes infinite allowances for the router and the transaction origin.
Constructor references routerForUniswap when granting the infinite allowance.
Bot protection address parameter flows into the PimpMyInu constructor.
Constructor argument is forwarded to the BotProtected base constructor.
Parameter is consumed by the BotProtected constructor.
stopTheBots state variable is written from the constructor parameter.
checkBots reads the stopTheBots oracle address before performing the call.
checkBots forwards uniPair as part of the oracle payload.
checkBots executes the raw external call encoded with selector 0x15274141.
The external call to the bot protection oracle happens before balance/allowance state updates in transferFrom, allowing the callee to reenter transferFrom/approve.
checkBots parameter _from is encoded into the oracle call.
checkBots parameter _to is encoded into the oracle call.
checkBots parameter _value is encoded into the oracle call.
notABot receives the success flag of the raw call and gates the modifier body.
isNotBot receives the raw returndata of the oracle call, which is never decoded.
transferFrom is guarded by the checkBots modifier before any state change.
msg.sender is compared with _from to decide whether spender allowance must be consumed.
_from parameter drives allowance checks and the balance debit.
_to parameter drives the balance credit.
_value parameter drives both unchecked subtractions and the addition.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
balanceOf[_from] is the operand of the unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
transferFrom executes balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
Unchecked arithmetic writes back into the balanceOf mapping, allowing balance inflation if total supply invariants are broken.
transferFrom reads and mutates the allowance mapping.
transferFrom performs allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value with raw unchecked subtraction.
Unchecked allowance decrement is written to the allowance mapping.
PimpMyInu.transfer delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
_to parameter of transfer flows into transferFrom.
_value parameter of transfer flows into transferFrom.
transfer uses msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
_spender parameter is used as the allowance key in approve.
_value parameter is written as the allowance amount in approve.
approve mutates the allowance mapping.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing an arbitrary delegatecall.
The owner state variable is read to authorize the delegatecall.
The delegatecall target is fully attacker-supplied once the owner check passes.
The delegatecall calldata is fully attacker-supplied.
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall, giving the callee control over this contract's storage.
Delegatecalled code executes in this contract's context and can overwrite the owner storage slot.
list() requires msg.sender == owner, so the privileged path depends on caller identity.
owner is read to authorize list().
list() builds the Uniswap deadline from block.timestamp + 600, a miner-manipulable value.
_numList parameter is written to balanceOf[address(this)] and used as the token liquidity amount.
_toWho parameter drives the recipient loop that overwrites balances.
_amounts parameter drives the amount loop that overwrites balances.
list() requires _toWho.length == _amounts.length before the distribution loop.
Loop index i bounds the unbounded distribution loop over _toWho/_amounts.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 is computed inside list() without SafeMath to rewrite the caller's balance.
list() reads the public totalSupply constant when allocating the owner share.
list() writes arbitrary balanceOf entries, including the contract's own balance, bypassing transfer accounting.
list() performs a raw .call to stopTheBots with selector 0xd5eaf4c3 after mutating state.
The raw call inside list() targets the stopTheBots state variable.
The external stopTheBots call occurs after balance writes, allowing an untrusted oracle to reenter list()/transferFrom before the loop completes.
list() forwards msg.value to the router via addLiquidityETH.
routerForUniswap is the target of the addLiquidityETH external payable call.
The router callback completes inside list() and its return values are ignored.
pairFor returns the derived pair address into the pair local variable.
tokenA parameter participates in the ordered token selection and CREATE2 hash.
tokenB parameter participates in the ordered token selection and CREATE2 hash.
token0 local receives the lexicographically smaller token.
token1 local receives the lexicographically larger token.
wrappedBinance is used as tokenA when deriving the Uniswap pair.
SafeMath.add computes and returns the local intermediate sum c.
ERC20.transfer calls the internal _transfer routine.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.
ERC20.transferFrom calls _transfer for the value movement.
ERC20.transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
ERC20.approve calls _approve.
_mint credits the _balances mapping.
_burn debits the _balances mapping.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
ERC20.transfer passes msg.sender as the sender to _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom passes msg.sender as the spender for allowance accounting.
ERC20.approve passes msg.sender as the allowance owner.
